Class PluggableStatEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.dod.PluggableStatEngine
public class PluggableStatEngine extends Object
Pluggable Statistics invalid input: '&' Formulas Registry for Ether. Manages custom user-defined statistical formulas, calculates metrics over H3 cells / WorldBuffer, and supports import/export to JSON / Properties files.
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
